verdict.rationale: Lithic's ASA feature lets a customer's own system approve/decline each authorization via HTTP callback, which is the mechanical basis for just-in-time funding decisions, and spend limits/rules imply program-level balance controls. However, there is no explicit documentation contrasting a 'prefunded balance' model against JIT funding, nor any discussion of the cash-flow tradeoffs between the two approaches. missing for 10: explicit prefunded-balance funding model docs, side-by-side comparison of prefunded vs JIT cash-flow implications, guidance for finance leads on choosing between them.
